language_content: {"en": {"stem": "What is the state bird of Uttar Pradesh?", "options": {"A": "Sarus Crane (सारस/क्रौंच)", "B": "Peacock (मोर)", "C": "Great Indian Bustard (गोडावण)", "D": "House Sparrow (गौरैया)"}, "solution": "The state bird of Uttar Pradesh is the Sarus Crane (सारस/क्रौंच)."}, "hi": {"stem": "उत्तर प्रदेश का राजकीय पक्षी कौन-सा है?", "options": {"A": "Sarus Crane (सारस/क्रौंच)", "B": "Peacock (मोर)", "C": "Great Indian Bustard (गोडावण)", "D": "House Sparrow (गौरैया)"}, "solution": "उत्तर प्रदेश का राजकीय पक्षी सारस अथवा क्रौंच (Sarus Crane) है।"}}
